name: team_planning_plans
description: List the Team Planning plans the caller is a member of, with each one's name, base date and the caller's role in it (editor or viewer), and archived_on, the day it was archived, or null for a live plan. state picks which: live (the default), archived or all. Being a tenant admin or a planner adds no plans.
